response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of robust software engineering experience and a valuable entrepreneurial background, he lacks the deep, recognized AI expertise and Director-level strategic leadership required for this Principal Engineer role. His AI exposure appears very recent and hands-on rather than strategic, which does not align with the expectation of driving high-level AI strategy and advising enterprise customers at a Director level.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience, meeting the minimum tenure requirement.
Entrepreneurial background as the founder of GISCollective, fulfilling a preferred qualification.
Demonstrated ability to inspire others internally and externally through open-source projects, workshops, and conference talks.
concerns: Lacks Director-level strategic leadership and enterprise customer advisory experience.
AI/ML expertise is very recent and falls short of the 'recognized expertise' preferred for this strategy role.
Does not hold an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in an AI-related field.
